Name: Bold And Brash
Author: Cedarwood7916
Description:
It's a 2x2 painting. I think its pretty neat and funny. Have fun.

To install, download this and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url]. Right click them in your file explorer and select 'extract all'. drag the extracted files into your mods folder. That's it!

To get the painting in-game, either buy it from Robin for 100g, or find it in the furniture catalogue. It won't appear in the CJB Item Spawner

Manifest.Name: Bold & Brash
Manifest.Description: Adds Squidward's beautiful painting to Stardew Valley
Manifest.Author: Cedarwood7916
